shortDescription: 8-week five-day body-part hypertrophy split from the fundamentals book.
descriptionHtml:
8-week five-day body-part hypertrophy split from the fundamentals book.

Structure: 8 weeks, 5 scheduled sessions per week, 48 referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Chest & Triceps, Legs & Abs #1, Back & Biceps, Legs & Abs #2, and Shoulders & Arms.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: beginner
  • Duration: 8 weeks
  • Tags: body part split and 5 days per week
